title: Publication
description: Something this project said outside itself: the text as it went out, where it went, and when.
guidance: Written when a post has actually gone out, and not before. Its body is the text exactly as it left — that is the whole reason it is a record of its own rather than a field on the draft: a draft edited afterwards would otherwise rewrite what was said. Write one as soon as the post is delivered, archive the draft it came from, and link the two with `sent_from`. Do not edit one. If what went out was wrong, that is a new post saying so — a correction is a thing that happened, not a thing that unhappens.

network.description: Which service it went to. Required, and held here rather than only on the channel: a channel can be deleted or reconnected to another account, and this record has to keep saying where the post is — it is an account of an event, and an event does not change because a setting did.

channel.description: The key of the `posts.channel` record it went out through, when that is known. Provenance rather than the fact itself: what matters is in `network` and in the body, and this only says which of several accounts was used.

sent.description: When it went out, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Required, because a publication is an account of an event and an event with no time is not one.

identifier.description: What the network calls this post — a URN, a numeric id, an AT URI — read from its own answer. The only handle anybody has on it afterwards. Not required, deliberately: where it cannot be got, a record of what was said and when is still worth far more than no record at all.

visibility.description: Who could read it, as it was actually sent, in its network's own vocabulary. Kept beside the text for the same reason the text is kept: what a draft says now is not evidence of what was agreed to then.

sent_from.description: The draft this was written from, for the provenance. A pointer and never a source: the text lives here, so this link may be followed for context and never for what was said.
